papers.title: Germline Genetic Variants and Epilepsy Surgery Response: Individual Participant Pooled Analysis of 272 Patients.
papers.title_zh: 种系遗传变异和癫痫手术反应： 272名患者的个体参与者汇总分析。
authors: Pediatric Epilepsy Research Consortium (PERC) Surgery Workgroup, and the Pediatric Epilepsy Research Consortium (PERC) Genetics Workgroup
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND AND OBJECTIVES: Genetic testing is increasingly used in presurgical evaluation, but the yield of resection and ablation across germline genetic epilepsies remains uncertain.
METHODS: We conducted a systematic review of MEDLINE (PubMed) and Scopus and added cases from 3 institutional cohorts and the Pediatric Epilepsy Research Consortium (PERC) databases, including individuals with pathogenic/likely pathogenic germline variants besides tuberous sclerosis who underwent resection or laser ablation. Etiologies were grouped into biologically informed categories (GATORopathies, vascular, overgrowth, copy number variants (CNVs), channelopathies, synaptopathies, and other). Primary outcome was seizure freedom (Engel I) at the last follow-up. Group comparisons used Fisher exact and Kruskal-Wallis tests (α = 0.05; Bonferroni when applicable). Prespecified sensitivity analyses stratified by lesional status, excluded GATORopathies, and restricted to literature-only cases.
RESULTS: We included 224 literature cases (65 studies), 36 institutional cases, and 12 PERC cases (n = 272). The median follow-up was 24 months (interquartile range 12-48.0). Seizure freedom was achieved in vascular disorders 14/19 (73.6%), GATORopathies 79/120 (65.8%), CNVs 18/31 (58.0%), overgrowth 9/16 (56.6%), channelopathies 13/43 (30.0%), synaptopathies 4/18 (22.2%), and other 11/25 (44.0%) (overall  p  < 0.001). Among cases with available imaging results, 208/253 (82.2%) had epileptogenic MRI lesions, including 64% of channelopathies and 80% of the synaptopathies. In univariate contrasts (each category vs all others), odds of seizure freedom were higher for vascular disorders (2.64-fold, 95% CI 0.87-9.65) and GATORopathies (2.41-fold, 95% CI 1.44-4.09), and lower for synaptopathies (∼4.2-fold lower, OR 0.23, 95% CI 0.05-0.77) and channelopathies (∼4.5-fold lower, OR 0.22, 95% CI 0.09-0.48). Direction and magnitude were consistent across prespecified sensitivity analyses (lesional only, literature only, exclusion of GATORopathies).
DISCUSSION: Resective surgeries can be effective in germline genetic epilepsies, but outcomes vary by pathway. Disorders with discrete, lesional substrates (GATORopathies, vascular) show the highest likelihood of seizure freedom, whereas channelopathies and synaptopathies, despite the presence of MRI lesions, have substantially lower yields even in lesional cases. Prospective, genotype-aware surgical registries with standardized reporting (EEG, imaging, and pathology) and time-to-event outcomes are needed to refine the selection of surgical candidates and quantify seizure and non-seizure-related outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh:
背景和目标：基因检测越来越多地用于术前评估，但种系遗传性癫痫的切除和消融产量仍不确定。
方法：我们对MEDLINE （ PubMed ）和Scopus进行了系统评价，并添加了来自3个机构队列和儿科癫痫研究联盟（ PERC ）数据库的病例，其中包括具有致病性/可能致病性种系变异的个体，以及
接受切除或激光消融的结节性硬化症。病因被分为生物学上知情的类别（ GATORopathies、血管、过度生长、拷贝数变异（ CNV ）、通道病变、突触病变等）。主要转归为末次随访时的癫痫发作自由度（ Engel I ）。组比较使用Fisher精确检验和Kruskal-Wallis检验（ α = 0.05 ； Bonferroni ，如适用）。预先指定的敏感性分析已分层
病变状态，排除GATORopathies ，仅限于文献病例。
结果：我们纳入了224个文献病例（ 65项研究）、36个机构病例和12个PERC病例（ n = 272 ）。 中位随访时间为24个月（四分位数间距12-48.0 ）。 血管疾病14/19 (73.6%)、GATORopathies 79/120 (65.8%)、CNVS 18/31 (58.0%)、过度生长9/16 (56.6%)、通道病变13/43 (30.0%)、突触病变4/
18 （ 22.2% ） ，以及其他11/25 （ 44.0% ） （总体p < 0.001 ）。在有可用影像学结果的病例中， 208/253 （ 82.2% ）有癫痫性MRI病变，包括64%的通道病变和80%的突触病变。在单变量对比中（每个类别与所有其他类别相比） ，血管疾病（ 2.64倍， 95 ％ CI 0.87-9.65 ）和GATORopathies （ 2.41倍， 95 ％ CI 1.44-4.09 ）的癫痫发作自由度几率较高，突触病变（ ∼ 4.2倍低
er ， OR 0.23 ， 95% CI 0.05-0.77 ）和通道病变（降低约4.5倍， OR 0.22 ， 95% CI 0.09-0.48 ）。 在预先指定的敏感性分析（仅病灶、仅文献、排除GATORopathies ）中，方向和幅度是一致的。
讨论：切除手术在生殖系遗传性癫痫中可能是有效的，但结果因途径而异。 具有离散的病变底物（ GATORopathies ，血管）的疾病显示出最高的可能性
癫痫发作自由，而尽管存在MRI病变，但即使在病变情况下，通道病变和突触病变的产量也要低得多。需要具有标准化报告（脑电图、成像和病理学）和事件发生时间结果的前瞻性基因型感知手术登记，以改进手术候选者的选择并量化癫痫发作和非癫痫发作相关结果。

papers.title: Global Epidemiology of Neonatal and Infantile-Onset Epilepsies and Epilepsy Syndromes (GENIE): A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
papers.title_zh: 新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫和癫痫综合征（ GENIE ）的全球流行病学：系统评价和荟萃分析。
papers.abstract:
IMPORTANCE: Despite the profound impact of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies on neurodevelopmental outcomes and mortality, consolidated global epidemiological evidence remains lacking.
OBJECTIVES: To estimate the global incidence and prevalence of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies and epilepsy syndromes and to characterize their associated etiological profiles.
DATA SOURCES: PubMed, Embase, Web of Science, and Scopus were searched from inception through December 18, 2025.
STUDY SELECTION: Population-based observational studies reporting the incidence or prevalence of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies or epilepsy syndromes were eligible for inclusion.
DATA EXTRACTION AND SYNTHESIS: Two authors independently and in duplicate performed study selection, data extraction, and quality assessment of included studies using the Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal checklist for prevalence studies. Generalized linear mixed-model random-effects meta-analysis was used to pool the estimates of incidence, prevalence, and etiology. Subgroup meta-analyses were conducted by country, World Health Organization (WHO) region, World Bank income, and diagnostic criteria. Metaregression was used to investigate the association between study-level covariates and pooled incidence estimates of infantile-onset epilepsy syndromes.
MAIN OUTCOMES AND MEASURES: Cumulative incidence and prevalence of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies and epilepsy syndromes.
RESULTS: A total of 86 population-based studies from 30 countries across 4 WHO regions were included. The pooled cumulative incidence of infantile-onset epilepsies within the first 2 years of life was 236.0 cases (95% CI, 164.7-338.2; 95% prediction interval [PI], 53.0-1044.3) per 100 000 live births. Among epilepsy syndrome subgroups, developmental and epileptic encephalopathies (DEEs) had the highest incidence at 67.7 cases (95% CI, 42.1-108.9; 95% PI, 7.1-636.1) per 100 000 live births. Infantile epileptic spasms syndrome (IESS) was the most incident DEE, with 31.6 cases (95% CI, 27.5-36.2; 95% PI, 13.7-72.6) per 100 000 live births. Among self-limited epilepsies, self-limited infantile epilepsy had the highest incidence at 13.0 cases (95% CI, 9.2-18.2; 95% PI, 6.4-26.4) per 100 000 live births. Subgroup analyses revealed limited geographical representativeness, with the majority of studies from high-income countries in the European Region.
CONCLUSIONS AND RELEVANCE: The findings underscore a significant global burden of neonatal and infantile-onset epilepsies, primarily driven by DEEs, specifically IESS. Given substantial between-study heterogeneity, the pooled estimates should be interpreted as broad indicators rather than precise, generalizable rates. Geographic disparities, with a lack of data from the African and Eastern Mediterranean Regions, underscore the need for population-based studies in underrepresented regions and longitudinal research on survival, remission, and functional outcomes.
papers.abstract_zh:
重要性：尽管新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫对神经发育结局和死亡率产生了深远影响，但仍缺乏综合的全球流行病学证据。
目的：估计新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫和癫痫综合征的全球发病率和患病率，并表征其相关的病因特征。
数据来源：搜索了PubMed、Embase、Web of Science和Scopus
直至2025年12月18日。
研究选择：报告新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫或癫痫综合征的发生率或患病率的基于人群的观察性研究符合纳入标准。
数据提取和合成：两名作者使用Joanna Briggs Institute Critical Appraisal （乔安娜·布里格斯研究所批判性评估）检查表独立进行研究选择、数据提取和纳入研究的质量评估，一式两份
用于患病率研究。使用广义线性混合模型随机效应荟萃分析来汇总发病率、患病率和病因学的估计。 按国家、世界卫生组织（ WHO ）地区、世界银行收入和诊断标准进行亚组荟萃分析。 Metaregression用于研究婴儿发病性癫痫综合征的研究水平协变量与汇总发病率估计之间的关联。
主要
结局和措施：新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫和癫痫综合征的累积发病率和患病率。
结果：共纳入了来自4个世卫组织区域30个国家的86项基于人群的研究。 出生后2年内婴儿发病癫痫的累计发病率为每10万例活产236.0例（ 95% CI ， 164.7-338.2 ； 95%预测间隔[PI] ， 53.0-1044.3 ）。在癫痫综合征中
发育性脑病和癫痫性脑病（ DEEs ）的发生率最高，为每10万例活产67.7例（ 95% CI ， 42.1-108.9 ； 95% PI ， 7.1-636.1 ）。婴儿癫痫痉挛综合征（ IESS ）是发生率最高的DEE ，每10万例活产中有31.6例（ 95% CI ， 27.5-36.2 ； 95% PI ， 13.7-72.6 ）。在自限性癫痫中，自限性婴幼儿癫痫的发病率最高，为13.0例（ 95% CI ， 9.2-18.2 ； 95% PI
， 6.4-26.4 ）每10万例活产。 亚组分析显示地域代表性有限，大多数研究来自欧洲地区的高收入国家。
结论和相关性：研究结果强调了新生儿和婴儿发病癫痫的重大全球负担，主要由DEE驱动，特别是IESS。 鉴于研究之间存在显著的异质性，汇总的估计应解释为
d指标，而不是精确的、可概括的比率。地理差异，缺乏来自非洲和东地中海地区的数据，强调需要在代表性不足的地区进行基于人群的研究，并对生存、缓解和功能结局进行纵向研究。

papers.title: Diagnostic value of extending outpatient EEG to record sleep - A retrospective study.
papers.title_zh: 扩展门诊脑电图以记录睡眠的诊断价值-一项回顾性研究。
papers.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Evidence for the utility of sleep electroencephalography (EEG) in the diagnosis of epilepsy is inconsistent, often necessitating repeat visits and sleep deprivation (SD), which increases patient and resource burden. In our setting in India, patients are often referred for EEG immediately following consultation (single visit) and EEG sessions are extended to allow for spontaneous sleep acquisition without prior SD. We aimed to evaluate the success rate of achieving sleep during these extended outpatient recordings and its incremental diagnostic yield for interictal epileptiform discharges (IEDs).
METHODS: We retrospectively analyzed 1762 outpatient EEGs from patients (45% female) with suspected or known epilepsy. All patients underwent an extended routine EEG (~40-50 min), incorporating standard activation procedures and aiming to capture spontaneous sleep where possible. Successful sleep acquisition was defined as the attainment of at least NREM stage N2. IED detection rates were compared between wakefulness and sleep across different epilepsy types.
RESULTS: Sleep was achieved in 70.5% of patients (median age, 28 years; IQR: 16-55; range, 0.3-90). The proportion attaining sleep increased with recording duration, from 36.7% at 20 min to 55.6% at 30 min and 66.7% at 50 min, with a median time to sleep onset of 20 min. Among 1199 patients with both awake and sleep states captured, wakefulness identified IEDs in 29% (n = 350), while sleep captured unique IEDs in an additional 12% (n = 141), increasing the total yield significantly. In a sub-analysis of confirmed epilepsy cases (n = 751), wakefulness showed IEDs in 42% (n = 315), with sleep adding another 16% (n = 123). The diagnostic yield of sleep recordings was significantly higher than that of wakefulness alone (OR: 1.31; 95% CI: 1.02-1.68; p = 0.043), particularly among adults with idiopathic generalized epilepsy (IGE) (OR: 2.20; 95% CI: 1.30-3.73; p = 0.004) and children with self-limited epilepsy (OR: ∞; p = 0.031).
SIGNIFICANCE: Despite a busy outpatient setting, 70.5% of patients attained N2 sleep during an extended EEG recording without SD. Sleep capture increased progressively with recording duration, with the greatest incremental gain between 20 and 30 min, suggesting that a modest extension beyond 20 min substantially increases the likelihood of capturing sleep. Sleep recording increased IED detection over wakefulness alone, particularly in children, in adults with IGE, and in self-limited epilepsies. Whether this approach can substitute for a sleep-deprived EEG requires prospective, head-to-head evaluation.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：睡眠脑电图（ EEG ）在癫痫诊断中的应用证据不一致，通常需要重复就诊和睡眠剥夺（ SD ） ，这增加了患者和资源负担。在我们位于印度的环境中，患者通常在会诊（单次访视）后立即转诊进行脑电图检查，并延长脑电图会话，以允许自发睡眠采集，而无需事先进行SD。我们的目的是评估
在这些扩展门诊记录期间实现睡眠的成功率及其对发作性癫痫间期出院（ IED ）的增量诊断率。
方法：我们回顾性分析了1762例疑似或已知癫痫患者（ 45%为女性）的门诊脑电图。 所有患者均接受了延长的常规脑电图（约40-50分钟） ，包括标准激活程序，旨在尽可能捕捉自发睡眠。Succe
ssful睡眠采集被定义为至少达到NREM N2期。 比较了不同类型癫痫患者的清醒和睡眠IED检出率。
结果： 70.5%的患者实现了睡眠（中位年龄为28岁； IQR ： 16-55 ；范围为0.3-90 ）。 实现睡眠的比例随着记录持续时间的增加而增加，从20分钟时的36.7%增加到30分钟时的55.6%和50分钟时的66.7% ，中位睡眠时间为20分钟。
在捕获的1199名具有清醒和睡眠状态的患者中，清醒识别出29% （ n = 350 ）的简易爆炸装置，而睡眠识别出另外12% （ n = 141 ）的独特简易爆炸装置，显著增加了总产量。在对确诊癫痫病例（ n = 751 ）的子分析中，清醒显示IED占42% （ n = 315 ） ，睡眠增加了16% （ n = 123 ）。睡眠记录的诊断率明显高于清醒记录的诊断率。
ne （ OR ： 1.31 ； 95% CI ： 1.02-1.68 ； p = 0.043 ） ，尤其是特发性全身性癫痫（ IGE ）成人（ OR ： 2.20 ； 95% CI ： 1.30-3.73 ； p = 0.004 ）和自限性癫痫儿童（ OR ： ∞ ； p = 0.031 ）。
意义：尽管门诊环境繁忙， 70.5%的患者在没有SD的扩展脑电图记录期间达到N2睡眠。 睡眠捕获随着记录持续时间逐渐增加，最大的增量增益介于
20和30分钟，表明适度延长超过20分钟大大增加了捕获睡眠的可能性。与单纯清醒相比，睡眠记录增加了IED检测，特别是在儿童、IGE成人和自限性癫痫中。这种方法是否可以替代睡眠不足的脑电图需要前瞻性的直接评估。

papers.title: Utilizing wearable activity trackers to promote physical activity in people with epilepsy: a randomized controlled trial.
papers.title_zh: 利用可穿戴活动跟踪器促进癫痫患者的身体活动：一项随机对照试验。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To evaluate exercise education alone versus exercise education in combination with a wearable physical activity tracker in people with epilepsy (PWE) to determine the effect on physical activity and measure potential impact on depression, anxiety, sleep, and quality of life (QoL).
METHODS: In an open parallel group prospective randomized controlled trial, PWE between 18 and 64 years old were recruited from a single US epilepsy center. Eligible participants were randomized into two groups (control and intervention arms). Both arms received standard-of-care exercise education for PWE. The intervention arm also received a Fitbit for data monitoring and smartphone-application-based physical activity challenge opportunities. Both arms provided self-reported physical activity metrics at enrollment and study completion. Fitbit data were collected from each participant in the intervention arm continuously for three months. Secondary outcome measures for depression, anxiety, sleep, and QoL were also assessed at baseline and post-intervention. Seizure frequency was monitored as an adverse event.
RESULTS: Eighty participants were recruited (40 intervention, 40 control). There was a significant increase in aerobic physical activity level after three months within the intervention arm and a nonsignificant positive trend within the control arm. There was a nonsignificant improvement in depression and anxiety scores in both arms. There was no significant change in sleep or QoL and no adverse impact on seizure frequency.
SIGNIFICANCE: The use of wearable physical activity trackers in conjunction with smartphone-application-based physical activity challenges and exercise education resulted in a within-intervention-arm improvement in aerobic physical activity in PWE with no change in seizure frequency.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：评估癫痫患者（ PWE ）单纯运动教育与运动教育联合可穿戴式身体活动追踪器，以确定对身体活动的影响，并衡量对抑郁、焦虑、睡眠和生活质量（ QOL ）的潜在影响。
方法：在一项开放式平行组前瞻性随机对照试验中，从单个美国癫痫中心招募18至64岁的PWE。
符合条件的参与者被随机分为两组（对照组和干预组）。两组均接受了PWE的标准护理运动教育。干预部门还获得了Fitbit的数据监控和基于智能手机应用程序的体育活动挑战机会。两组均在入组和研究完成时提供自我报告的身体活动指标。从干预中的每个参与者收集了Fitbit数据
手臂连续三个月。 在基线和干预后还评估了抑郁、焦虑、睡眠和生活质量的次要结局指标。 将癫痫发作频率作为不良事件进行监测。
结果：招募了80名参与者（ 40名干预人员， 40名对照人员）。 干预组内有氧体力活动水平在三个月后显著增加，
对照组，两组抑郁和焦虑评分均无明显改善。 睡眠或生活质量无显著变化，对癫痫发作频率无不良影响。
意义：使用可穿戴式体育活动跟踪器与基于智能手机应用程序的体育活动挑战和运动教育相结合，导致PWE中有氧体育活动的干预内改善，
癫痫发作频率的激怒。

papers.title: Prescriptions for seizure cluster rescue therapy are not associated with decreased pediatric ED utilization.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫丛集抢救治疗处方与儿科ED利用率降低无关。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Seizure clusters, or acute repetitive seizures, are a phenomenon often experienced by patients with epilepsy and pose a significant treatment challenge for clinicians. Several rescue medications have been approved by the Food and Drug Administration for the treatment of seizure clusters - including diazepam rectal gel, intranasal midazolam, and intranasal diazepam - which are commonly prescribed for prolonged seizures or status epilepticus (SE). Conflicting evidence exists relating to the impact of seizure cluster treatment on hospital care utilization and health-related quality of life (HRQoL). We hypothesized that children prescribed rescue medication specifically including an indication for seizure clusters would have fewer seizure-related Emergency Department (ED) visits compared to those prescribed rescue medications only for SE.
METHODS: This study was a cross-sectional cohort study from a single pediatric center. A total of 3216 children with epilepsy and rescue medications were included. Measured characteristics included sociodemographic factors, epilepsy features, HRQoL, and healthcare utilization. We modeled the probability of having ED visits for seizures in the 12 months following prescriptions of rescue medication for either SE only or both SE and seizure clusters.
RESULTS: There was no difference in ED utilization between patients receiving a rescue prescription for SE only (n = 48, 3.1%) or both SE and seizure clusters (n = 64, 3.8%) (OR 1.12; 95% CI 0.74-1.71; p = 0.6). A multivariable model was created to evaluate factors associated with ED utilization. The acute social needs score was the only measured variable associated with increased odds of having a subsequent ED visit (OR 1.37; 95% CI 1.22-1.53; p < 0.001).
SIGNIFICANCE: There was no difference in ED utilization between patients receiving a rescue medication prescription including seizure clusters and those only for SE. The social needs score was the only measured variable in this study associated with increased ED visits. These results highlight that prescribing rescue medications for cluster seizures may have less impact on healthcare utilization than acute social needs.
PLAIN LANGUAGE SUMMARY: Seizure clusters are repetitive seizures that are poorly defined, and the consequences of treating them are unclear. While some providers prescribe benzodiazepines for use during these episodes, others do not. Using a large single-center database of over 3000 children, we found that having a prescription for a benzodiazepine to use during cluster seizures did not reduce emergency department (ED) use compared to patients with prescriptions for treating only life-threatening prolonged seizures. In this dataset, the only patient characteristic associated with ED utilization was the presence of an acute social need, such as food insecurity, suggesting that interventions targeting social needs may be more effective in reducing healthcare utilization in children with epilepsy.
papers.abstract_zh:
目的：癫痫发作簇或急性重复性癫痫发作是癫痫患者经常经历的现象，对临床医生构成重大治疗挑战。几种救援药物已被美国食品和药物管理局批准用于治疗癫痫发作簇-包括地西泮直肠凝胶，鼻内咪达唑仑和鼻内地西泮-这些药物通常用于长期癫痫发作或癫痫持续状态
iCUS (SE).关于癫痫发作集群治疗对医院护理利用率和健康相关生活质量(HRQoL)的影响存在相互矛盾的证据。 我们假设，与仅用于SE的处方救援药物相比，专门用于癫痫发作集群的处方救援药物的儿童与癫痫发作相关的急诊科（ ED ）就诊次数较少。
方法：本研究为横断面

papers.title: Quantification of peri-ictal magnetic resonance imaging abnormalities (PMA) in status epilepticus: Clinical and prognostic significance of PMA volume.
papers.title_zh: 癫痫持续状态下围发作期磁共振成像异常（ PMA ）的定量： PMA体积的临床和预后意义。
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: Peri-ictal magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) abnormalities (PMA) are increasingly recognized in patients with status epilepticus (SE), but the clinical factors influencing their occurrence and extent remain incompletely understood. We aimed to quantify PMA and investigate the associations of PMA occurrence and volume with SE duration, etiology, and mortality.
METHODS: In this multicenter cohort study, comprising a retrospectively identified cohort and a prospectively recruited cohort, adult patients with SE who underwent brain MRI within 48 h of SE onset were included. PMA were identified on diffusion-weighted imaging (DWI) and quantified using an automated postprocessing pipeline to calculate total PMA volume. Multivariable regression analyses were used to examine factors associated with PMA occurrence, extent, and mortality.
RESULTS: Of 260 patients, 91 (35%) had PMA on DWI. In multivariable analyses, SE duration and etiology were independently associated with PMA occurrence and volume. SE lasting >60 min had higher odds of PMA (odds ratio [OR] = 3.90, 95% confidence interval [CI] = 1.79-8.82, p < .001) and significantly greater PMA volume, whereas acute triggering factors in patients with epilepsy were linked with lower odds (OR = .15, 95% CI = .05-.44, p < .001). PMA occurrence was associated with more than threefold higher odds of mortality (adjusted OR = 3.85, 95% CI = 1.55-10.24, p = .005). Each 10-fold increase in PMA volume was associated with 43% higher odds of mortality (adjusted OR = 1.43, 95% CI = 1.14-1.80, p = .002). In a sensitivity analysis restricted to in-hospital mortality, each 10-fold increase in PMA volume was associated with 47% higher odds of mortality (adjusted OR = 1.47, 95% CI = 1.15-1.89, p = .002).
SIGNIFICANCE: PMA extent is determined by SE duration and underlying etiology. Although MRI timing relative to SE termination could not always be determined, quantitative PMA assessment provides prognostic information beyond PMA presence alone, as increasing PMA volume is associated with progressively higher mortality. These findings support quantitative PMA burden as a potential imaging biomarker of SE severity and adverse outcome.

papers.title: Exploratory prediction of surgical outcomes in MRI-negative epilepsy using preoperative individualized morphometric networks.
papers.journal: Epileptic disorders : international epilepsy journal with videotape
papers.abstract:
OBJECTIVE: To explore whether preoperative individualized morphometric networks derived from structural MRI may provide discriminative information for predicting surgical outcomes in magnetic resonance imaging (MRI)-negative epilepsy.
METHODS: Thirty-one MRI-negative epilepsy patients who underwent epilepsy surgery were retrospectively included (17 seizure-free and 14 with seizure-recurrence) in this exploratory study. Individualized gray matter morphometric networks were constructed from preoperative T1-weighted MRI based on cortical thickness distribution features. Network-based statistics were used to identify outcome-related subnetworks. Graph-theoretical features extracted from these subnetworks were classified using a random vector functional link (RVFL) network. Model performance was evaluated using the area under the receiver operating characteristic curve (AUC).
RESULTS: Graph-theoretical analysis revealed differences in network properties between seizure-free and seizure-recurrence groups, particularly in degree centrality and nodal clustering coefficient of the right orbital middle frontal gyrus, left inferior occipital gyrus, and left fusiform gyrus (p < .05). The combined graph-theoretical model demonstrated the highest discriminative performance among the evaluated imaging models (AUC = .876) and outperformed the clinical-only benchmark model (AUC = .504), although performance estimates showed variability across repeated splits.
SIGNIFICANCE: This exploratory study suggests that individualized morphometric network features may contain information related to postoperative outcomes in MRI-negative epilepsy. However, these findings should be interpreted as preliminary and require confirmation in larger multicenter studies.

papers.title: Genotype and phenotype analyses of 689 individuals with PCDH19-clustering epilepsy.
papers.abstract: PCDH19-clustering epilepsy (PCDH19-CE) is an infantile-onset neurodevelopmental disorder characterised by clusters of seizures, typically triggered by fever. PCDH19-CE follows an unusual X-linked inheritance pattern whereby heterozygous females, and males with X-chromosome disomy or pathogenic postzygotic mosaic PCDH19 variants, are affected, while hemizygous males are spared. We aggregate published PCDH19 variants and their corresponding PCDH19-CE phenotypes to analyse phenotype-genotype correlations. Data extracted from 110 publications identified 689/735 (94%) individuals with PCDH19 variants and the typical PCDH19-CE phenotype. Three hundred seventy-three unique PCDH19 variants were identified; 195 were not recorded in ClinVar. Seizure onset prior to 12 months of age was associated with more severe intellectual disability (p < 0.001) and the presence of psychiatric morbidity (p = 0.001). There were no phenotypic differences between missense, nonsense, and frameshift variants or between individuals of different geographical backgrounds, which was assessed as a proxy for ancestry. Twenty-nine hemizygous males with constitutive PCDH19 variants did not exhibit the typical PCDH19-CE phenotype, suggesting that the identification of variants in these individuals likely results from chance or ascertainment bias. The correlation between earlier seizure onset and poorer neurodevelopmental outcomes emphasises a critical window for therapeutic intervention. The lack of phenotypic difference between variant types demonstrates that loss of PCDH19 function underpins PCDH19-CE. Moreover, the identification of PCDH19 cytoplasmic domain variants in 78 affected individuals challenges the traditional view that PCDH19-CE is caused primarily by defects in cell-cell adhesion, as variants in this domain are expected to disrupt the nuclear function(s) of PCDH19.

papers.title: State-dependent effects of rTMS on cognitive function in bipolar II disorder: A randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled trial.
papers.abstract:
BACKGROUND: Repetitive transcranial magnetic stimulation (rTMS) is a promising neuromodulatory approach for cognitive improvement in psychiatric disorders. However, whether concurrent cognitive engagement enhances rTMS-related effects remains unclear.
METHODS: In this exploratory, randomized, double-blind, sham-controlled 2 × 2 factorial trial, 96 euthymic patients with bipolar II disorder and subjective cognitive impairment were assigned to active or sham 10-Hz rTMS combined with either a complex or simple cognitive task. Stimulation targeted the left inferior parietal lobule (IPL) using robot-assisted neuronavigation and was delivered in 10 sessions over 5 consecutive days. The main outcomes included changes in working memory capacity and precision, subjective cognitive performance (Perceived Deficits Questionnaire, PDQ), and resting-state fMRI connectivity within hippocampal and IPL networks. Behavioral outcomes were analyzed using likelihood-based intention-to-treat linear mixed-effects models including time, stimulation, task condition, and their interactions. False-discovery-rate correction was applied across behavioral outcomes.
RESULTS: Eighty-three participants completed the trial. In the intention-to-treat analysis including all 96 randomized participants, no stimulation-by-task interaction survived correction for multiple comparisons. Nominal interactions were observed for overall angular error and angular error at set size 2, but both fell short of the corrected significance threshold. The active rTMS and simple cognitive task group showed the most consistent model-estimated within-group improvements across several working-memory outcomes; however, these patterns did not establish superiority over the other factorial conditions. PDQ scores decreased across all four groups, without significant stimulation, task, or interaction effects. Exploratory neuroimaging analyses indicated divergent functional-connectivity changes across intervention conditions.
CONCLUSIONS: This exploratory trial did not provide statistically robust evidence that concurrent complex cognitive engagement enhanced the acute working-memory effects of IPL-targeted 10-Hz rTMS in euthymic bipolar II disorder, suggesting that task type, cognitive load, and stimulation-task coupling warrant further systematic optimization in future neuromodulation studies.
TRIAL REGISTRATION: ClinicalTrials.gov identifier: NCT06782763.

papers.title: Limited Evidence for Non-Invasive Brain Stimulation as a Cognitive Enhancer in Neurodevelopmental Disorders: A Multilevel Meta-Analysis of Sham-Controlled Trials.
papers.abstract: Non-invasive brain stimulation (NIBS) is increasingly applied to ameliorate cognitive deficits in neurodevelopmental disorders (NDDs), including autism spectrum disorder (ASD), attention-deficit/hyperactivity disorder (ADHD), and intellectual disability, yet whether standardized scalp-based protocols produce reliable cognitive enhancement remains untested at scale. This study evaluates the transdiagnostic efficacy of NIBS on shared, non-core cognitive domains across NDDs, searching MEDLINE, PsycINFO, Embase, Web of Science, and the Cochrane Library from inception to January 2026. A three-level multivariate random-effects meta-analysis synthesized effect sizes while accounting for dependency among multiple outcomes contributed by the same study. From 9191 identified records (5237 after deduplication), 30 randomized sham-controlled trials yielding 178 effect sizes across seven cognitive domains were synthesized. NIBS did not significantly outperform sham for any domain: working memory (k=24; g=-0.16, 95% CI [-0.37, 0.05]), cognitive flexibility (k=11; g=-0.12 [-0.38, 0.13]), global executive function (k=8; g=-0.14 [-0.46, 0.18]), processing speed (k=8; g=-0.27 [-0.77, 0.23]), inhibitory control (k=4; g=-0.08 [-0.62, 0.46]), verbal fluency (k=5; g=-0.11 [-0.59, 0.38]), or self-monitoring/behavioral metacognition (k=4; g=0.13 [-0.60, 0.86]). The pooled cross-domain estimate reached nominal significance (g=-0.18, p=0.035) but fell below the small-effect threshold, and its wide prediction interval (95% PI [-1.01, 0.66]) spanned benefit and harm. Exploratory diagnosis-stratified analyses were likewise null in both ADHD and ASD (all p>0.10). Current unstandardized, "one-size-fits-all" NIBS protocols do not yield reliable cognitive enhancement across NDDs, exposing a translational bottleneck driven by methodological heterogeneity. Realizing NIBS therapeutic potential for cognition in NDDs will require a shift toward precision psychiatry, utilizing individualized neuro-navigation and state-dependent stimulation.
